title: Felix and the Witness
author: Dominic Coldharbour
blurb: Sable Eastwick, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the tide gives up what it took.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
